name: winnie-local
description: Customized personal Claude Code plugins for adding conditional LSPs.

plugins.name: deno-or-ts
plugins.description: Conditional LSP that auto-routes from workspace files: `deno lsp` if deno.json/deno.jsonc is found at or above the workspace root, with typescript-language-server as fallback. Replaces the official typescript-lsp plugin.

plugins.name: pyright-or-ruff
plugins.description: Conditional LSP that auto-routes from workspace files: `pyright-langserver` if pyrightconfig.json is found at or above the workspace root, with `ruff server` as fallback. Replaces the official pyright-lsp plugin.
